card.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 With A Home Button That Will Rapid Click When You Press It

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 With A Home Button That Will Rapid Click When You Press It

claims.statement: iPhone 7/8 home buttons are paired; a rapid 'machine gun' click is usually a torn screen-side home button flex, a cracked fold-over flex in the button, or a chipped Turtle IC U10.
Turtle IC U10 on the button flex is not paired and can be replaced; cracked traces can be jumpered (ZXW 'Phone7P_Touch').
Liquid corrosion inside the metal button shell is not practical to fix.

procedure: Inspect the screen's home button flex for tears.
Test the button on another screen.
Inspect the button flex and fold-over flex; jumper broken traces.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
